name: Audiophile
description: EasyEffects, patchbays, mixers, and PipeWire inspection for people who care how the machine sounds.

items.name: easyeffects
items.summary: System-wide EQ and effects (parametric EQ, convolver, crossfeed, dynamics) for PipeWire.

items.name: helvum
items.summary: GTK patchbay that shows the PipeWire node graph and connects ports by dragging.

items.name: qpwgraph
items.summary: Qt PipeWire graph manager with a patchbay that saves and restores connections.

items.name: pavucontrol
items.summary: GTK volume control for per-app streams, device selection, and card profiles.

items.name: pamixer
items.summary: Command-line volume mixer for keybindings and scripts.

items.name: ncpamixer
items.summary: ncurses terminal mixer modeled on pavucontrol.

items.name: coppwr
items.summary: Low-level PipeWire control: nodes, clock rate, quantum, metadata, and profiler stats.

items.name: alsa-utils
items.summary: ALSA command-line utilities: alsamixer, speaker-test, aplay, and arecord.

items.name: bluez
items.summary: Linux Bluetooth protocol stack daemon for pairing wireless audio devices.

items.name: bluez-utils
items.summary: Bluetooth management utilities including the bluetoothctl client.
